name: Inovance
name_zh: 深圳市汇川技术股份有限公司
summary: Inovance is a Chinese industrial automation and drive technology manufacturer. Its component portfolio includes servo drives, servo motors and precision direct-drive motion products. These components serve machine automation and motion-control applications alongside the group’s broader industrial businesses.
